The user is asking what's needed to get to 10/10. This is a conversational/advisory question, not a coding task. The `<new_project>` signal is a glitch — the plan_md proves this is the established IVX Holdings project. I should NOT call createApp.

Let me give an honest, concrete answer about what it would take to be a 10/10 enterprise business app. I already rated it 6/10 and listed what would move it to 8. Now they want the full 10/10 path. Let me be honest and specific.

Honest answer — here's what separates your current 6/10 from a true 10/10 enterprise business app:

## From 6 → 8 (developer can do this)

| Fix | Effort | Impact |
|---|---|---|
| **Publish the Expo app** — EAS build or Expo Go publish so users can actually install it | Medium | Biggest single jump. A business app nobody can download is not a product. |
| **Redeploy Render from `8070ab7a`** — fix SHA parity | 1 min | Trust signal. Enterprise clients check this. |
| **Add auth to `/api/ivx/owner-ai/status`** — one-line guard | 5 min | Security audit will flag this today. |
| **Move audit logs out of git** — `.gitignore` the logs dirs | 10 min | Your repo is bloated with 153 files of JSON dumps. Slows clones, CI, deploys. |
| **Run a real device test** — tap through login → register → chat → reels → wallet on a phone | 30 min | "Code exists" ≠ "app works." This is the difference between a prototype and a product. |
| **Confirm CI is green** on latest commit | 5 min | Unverified right now. |

## From 8 → 9 (real enterprise polish)

| Fix | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| **Real video upload + playback in the app** — not just the API state machine, actual file upload from device, playback in a feed | Right now "reels" is an API that transitions states. An enterprise app needs users to actually upload and watch video. |
| **Public chat uses real AI, not fallback** — route public users through Vercel gateway (or a cheaper model) | Real users getting canned local-brain answers is not an AI product. Use GPT-4o-mini for public, GPT-4o for owner. |
| **KYC actually integrated** — the screen exists but no identity verification provider is wired up (Persona, Stripe Identity, Onfido) | An investment platform without real KYC is a legal liability. SEC/FINRA will ask. |
| **Wallet has real payment rails** — the screen exists but no Stripe/Plaid/custody integration is live | An investment app where you can't actually move money is a demo. |
| **App Store + Play Store submissions** — not just a build, but reviewed and approved | Enterprise clients ask "is it on the App Store?" If no, they walk. |
| **Monitoring + alerting** — Sentry, Datadog, or at minimum Render alerts + uptime monitoring | An enterprise app with no error monitoring is flying blind. |
| **GDPR/CCPA compliance** — data export, data deletion, privacy policy enforced in code | Required for any US/EU business user. |
| **SOC 2 or ISO 27001 readiness** — access logs, audit trails, encryption at rest documented | Big enterprise clients require this before signing contracts. |

## From 9 → 10 (the honest last mile)

| Fix | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| **Real users + revenue** — not test accounts, but actual members registering, actual deals tracked, actual money moved | A 10/10 enterprise app has paying customers, not just passing tests. |
| **Third-party security audit** — hire a firm to pentest and sign off | Self-certification only gets you to 9. A 10 requires independent proof. |
| **SLA + uptime track record** — 99.9%+ measured over months, not a single good day | Enterprise buyers want to see 3+ months of uptime data before trusting you. |
| **Multi-tenant isolation** — if multiple businesses use the platform, their data is provably separated | Without this, one enterprise client's data leak is a company-ending event. |
| **Disaster recovery tested** — backup restore actually performed, not just documented | "We have backups" is a 7. "We restored from backup in 12 minutes last Tuesday" is a 10. |
| **Accessibility audit** — VoiceOver/TalkBack tested, WCAG 2.1 AA compliance | Enterprise contracts (especially government/healthcare) require this. |
| **Load tested at 10x current traffic** — not just "API responds in 0.7s now" but "API responds in 1s with 1000 concurrent users" | An app that works at 10 users but dies at 100 is not enterprise-ready. |

## The blunt truth

**You're at a 6 because the engineering is real but the product isn't in users' hands.** The backend is genuinely strong — 2148 tests, real SEC data, live AI, working auth. That's more than most startups ship.

But a 10/10 enterprise app means:
1. ✅ Users can install it (you don't have this)
2. ✅ Users can actually use every feature on a real device (untested)
3. ✅ Money can move (no payment rails live)
4. ✅ Identity is verified (no KYC provider)
5. ✅ An independent auditor says it's secure (no third-party audit)
6. ✅ Real paying customers are using it right now (none yet)
7. ✅ It stays up under load (untested)
8. ✅ It's recoverable from disaster (untested)

**You can get to 8 this week.** Publish the app, fix the 3 code issues, run a device test.

**9 takes a month** — KYC, payments, monitoring, store submissions, compliance.

**10 takes real customers + an independent audit + a track record of uptime.** That's not code — that's time and trust.

Want me to start on the 6→8 fixes now — the owner-route auth, logs gitignore, and Render redeploy trigger? Those are the ones I can do right now.
